text:
Alex: quick handoff for the late window (02:30-06:00 UTC). I'm handing primary to Leo, Mira will be secondary.
Alex: Notes up-front:
- Deploy window: infra team rolling FN autoscaling change at ~03:00 UTC. Might see short 5-10m elevated error spikes as pods cycle. Treat as expected unless >5% user-facing errors.
- Coverage gap: product analytics engineer out until 04:15 — if customers report billing/usage anomalies we may need to escalate to Jane in growth.
- Runbooks: watch `#runbooks/serving` and the embed-service pageflow doc. Link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/embed-service

Jordan: thanks — what's the paging matrix for this shift? quick list pls.
Alex: tl;dr:
- P0 (service down, >99% traffic impacted or major outage): page -> primary + secondary + oncall-englead -> all-hands bridge. Page via PagerDuty `P0` route and ping @channel on Slack.
- P1 (degraded: large % of users, errors >5% or sustained latency p99 > 10s for >5m): page -> primary + secondary + oncall-englead. Create bridge.
- P2 (partial degradation, errors <5% or isolated customers): page -> primary only, put notes in thread, escalate to secondary after 15m if no progress.
- P3 (informational / metrics anomaly): Slack thread only, ticket for follow-up.

Mira: adding operational checklist for escalate->customer-impact assessment:
1) Check p50/p95/p99 and error-rate by shard
2) Confirm scope: internal only / subset / global
3) If customer-facing and >5% affected -> notify CS and prepare templated message
4) If >30% affected -> tag as Sev1/Sev2 depending on duration

Sam: small tweak — for autoscaling blips we agreed earlier to treat transient spikes <3m as non-pager unless error rate spikes concurrently. so P1 threshold includes sustained >3m.
Alex: yup, included implicitly. I'll call out: sustained = >3m for immediate consideration, >5m for auto-escalate.

IncidentBot: [alert] 4023456795 - embed-service error rate 4.8% over 60s window (p95 latency 820ms)
Leo: seeing it in Grafana too. Digging into recent deploy logs.
Leo: first checks:
```
kubectl get pods -n serving | grep embed-service
kubectl logs -n serving deploy/embed-service -c main --tail=200
curl -s http://internal-metrics/embed | jq '.errors' 
```

Rachel: runbook snippet for errors >3%:
```
- check ingress/backpressure
- validate model cache warmup (kv-cache health)
- rotate replica if OOM or crashloop
- if kv-miss rate >10% -> consider rolling restart with cached snapshot
```
Link to full runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/embed-service#errors

Jordan: who do we page if embed-models are OOMing? ops or models?
Mira: page models-oncall after primary + secondary if it's model-serving OOMs or model weight load failures. If it's upstream infra (k8s node), page ops-sre.

OpsBot: scheduling: reminder to primary (Leo) at 03:05 UTC to confirm post-deploy healthcheck :bell:

Leo: I'm on primary. I'm going to pre-warm caches and keep a 5-min cadence for metrics checks for the next 20m. If error rate remains >5% for two consecutive 3m windows I'll escalate to Jordan (eng lead) and open a bridge.

Sam: add metric commands I use:
```
curl -s https://metrics.internal/query?service=embed-service | jq '.p99,.errors'
pd-query --since 5m --service "embed-service"
```

IncidentBot: simulation notice: running a P1 pager drill at 03:45 UTC — this is expected during test window. :rotating_light:

Alex: decision log for this handoff:
- Primary: Leo
- Secondary: Mira
- Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/embed-service
- Escalate to EngLead Jordan if unresolved >15m OR severity reaches P0
- If customer impact >30% escalate to CS lead @jane and prepare status update

Jordan: acknowledged. If you need me directly page `englead` channel or PagerDuty `P1` route. I'll join bridge immediately.

Leo: noted. I'll post updates every 5 minutes in this thread. first check in 02:35 UTC. :eyes:

Rachel: leaving post-deploy checklist here for whoever inherits next shift:
- confirm autoscaler targets
- snapshot kv-cache states
- validate SLO alerts (latency, error-rate)
- confirm rotation policy is active

Mira: if any tenant shows >10% errors, isolate traffic via feature-flag and scale model group.

Alex: thanks team. I'll be reachable until 03:00 UTC if you need context. otherwise I'll pick up the recap doc for next-day summary.

(End of thread)
